title: Claude Opus 4.8
summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 4.8，主打“诚实”特性：模型在不确定时会主动标注，减少无根据的自信断言。早期测试显示，Opus 4.8 更倾向于承认自身工作的不确定性，避免做出无法支持的声明。这一方向对提升 AI 可信度至关重要。

title: Anthropic raises $65B in Series H funding at $965B post-money valuation
summary: Anthropic 宣布完成 650 亿美元 H 轮融资，投后估值达 9650 亿美元，首次超越 OpenAI。本轮由 Altimeter Capital、Dragoneer、Greenoaks 和红杉资本领投，每家出资超 20 亿美元。这笔巨额融资标志着 AI 军备竞赛进入新阶段。

title: Biohub releases a world model of protein biology
raw_excerpt: Biohub has made its open discovery engine for protein structure prediction, design, and biological discovery available to researchers everywhere. The release includes ESMC, a state-of-the-art language model that has internalized the fundamental properties that govern protein biology; ESMFold2, a design engine designed to transform ESMC's sequence representations into atomically-resolved 3D structures of biomolecular complexes; and ESM Atlas, which makes ESMC's representations navigable across 6.8 billion protein sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures. All three models are freely available to the global scientific community.
summary: Biohub 发布蛋白质生物学世界模型，包括 ESMC（蛋白质语言模型）、ESMFold2（结构设计引擎）和 ESM Atlas（覆盖 68 亿序列的导航图谱）。所有模型免费开放，有望加速蛋白质结构预测与生物发现。

title: CNN sues Perplexity over ‘verbatim’ copycat articles
raw_excerpt: CNN has filed a lawsuit against Perplexity, claiming that the startup's AI tools generate "verbatim" copies of its work, as reported earlier by CNN . The lawsuit, filed in a New York court on Thursday , also alleges that Perplexity provides users with information locked behind CNN's subscription. Perplexity, which offers an AI "answer" engine along with the AI browser Comet, is accused of ignoring CNN's efforts "to recognize or block Perplexity's unidentified crawlers" from scraping its content. "Human beings report, research, write, edit, and create the content that Perplexity takes without permission or compensation," the lawsuit claims. I … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: CNN 起诉 AI 搜索公司 Perplexity，指控其 AI 工具“逐字”复制 CNN 文章，并绕过付费墙向用户提供付费内容。Perplexity 被指无视 CNN 的爬虫屏蔽措施。此案可能对 AI 内容聚合的版权边界产生重要影响。

title: ElevenLabs Music Generation Model
raw_excerpt: ElevenLabs has released Music v2, a music-generation model capable of switching genres mid-track while maintaining vocal and compositional coherence.
summary: ElevenLabs 发布 Music v2 音乐生成模型，支持在曲目中途切换音乐风格，同时保持人声和作曲连贯性。该模型在音乐 AI 领域实现了新的灵活性，为创意工具带来更多可能性。

title: More Devins in More Places
raw_excerpt: Cognition raised over $1B at a $26B valuation, with significant backing from major investors to expand Devin, an AI software engineer. Devin has significantly cut project times and improved automation for clients like Mercedes-Benz and Itaú. Cognition aims to further streamline software development by matching models to tasks while expanding its engineering capabilities.
summary: Cognition 以 260 亿美元估值完成超 10 亿美元 D 轮融资，用于扩展 AI 软件工程师 Devin。Devin 已为梅赛德斯-奔驰、Itaú 等客户大幅缩短项目时间，提升自动化水平。Cognition 计划通过为任务匹配模型来进一步简化软件开发。

title: Nvidia bets $150B on Taiwan as Trump's plan to make US an AI hub backfires
raw_excerpt: Nvidia will invest $150 billion a year to make sure that Taiwan remains at the epicenter of the AI revolution. The investment is aimed at cementing Taiwan as the world's tech manufacturing hub for a long time. Nvidia will create a new headquarters in Taiwan to expand its partnership with TSMC, benefit from close proximity to advanced packaging technology not yet available at TSMC's factories in the US, and boost its alliances with other nearby partners. Expanding the AI ecosystem helps Nvidia further its bottom line.
summary: 英伟达宣布每年投资 1500 亿美元，确保台湾继续作为 AI 革命中心。投资将用于扩大与台积电的合作、在台设立新总部，并利用台湾先进的封装技术。此举与特朗普将美国打造成 AI 中心的计划形成对比。
